biggest_catch: The friend must set up direct deposit OR make a $1,000 opening deposit, and the account must stay open in good standing for 60 days before either party is paid.
catches: Friend must qualify by setting up direct deposit or making a $1,000 minimum opening deposit (no minimum time the $1,000 must remain).
Account must remain open and in good standing for 60 days (positive balance, no restrictions/fraud).
Cap: up to 10 qualifying referrals per year (i.e., $500/year).
Incentives may be considered taxable income.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: First Oklahoma Bank's official page (firstoklahomabank.com/refer-a-friend/) runs a Refer a Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns $50 in cash for each qualifying friend, directly deposited into each account. Each customer may receive incentives for up to 10 qualifying referrals per year (i.e., $500/year).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: invite a friend by sharing the official webpage or giving them a referral card from any branch; the friend opens a new personal checking account, provides the referrer's name at account opening, and qualifies by either setting up direct deposit or making a minimum $1,000 opening deposit; the account must remain open and in good standing for 60 days.

c4.evidence: Timing: incentives are paid within 30 days after all qualification requirements are met.

eligibility: First Oklahoma Bank customers referring friends who open a new personal checking account; friend must provide the referrer's name at account opening.
notes: $50 each paid as cash directly deposited into accounts — not a gift card.
